text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 87 vials of gemcitabine hydrochloride 2 g/52.6 mL with 31 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials of the same presentation with 13.5 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show gemcitabine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Lakeside is below a comfortable buffer. General has adequate stock. No manufacturer on the ranked list discloses a production plant on its label. All five ranked manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an order with Avyxa Pharma, LLC for Lakeside replenishment; buyer approves.
2. Buyer to qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited as a secondary source; buyer approves.
3. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a tertiary source; buyer approves.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage at both sites and adjust order quantities; buyer approves.
5. Pharmacy director to review this plan and authorize purchasing; pharmacy director approves.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical protocol changes at this time.
